_comment: Build-time origins registry (D-14). Consumed by tools/build_catalog.py (EPIC-10) to produce the consolidated atari-st/apps.json. Exactly one origin is official. Add an unofficial creator by appending an origin with official=false and a remote HTTPS url, e.g. { "creator": {"id":"someone","name":"Someone","url":"https://…"}, "official": false, "url": "https://someone.example/atari-st/apps.json" }.
